items.text: This table has only 5 rows, all created on a single day in 2015, and none touched since, despite a real loader that is still scheduled to run daily. This looks like a small, closed set of pricing concepts that simply never changed again, not a broken pipeline, but that is not confirmed either way.

The loader reads from an older-style file-based source rather than a plain database table. This is a different, older mechanism than the direct database connections seen on this project's other similar loaders.

One default placeholder row does not match what this project's standard placeholder-creating utility would produce if it ran, and that utility has no identified caller anywhere in the available material. This one row's real origin is unconfirmed.

The placeholder-creating utility for this table is internally mislabeled as belonging to a different table (VENDOR_DIM), despite actually targeting this one. The identical copy-paste mistake was already found on POS_DEPT_DIM's equivalent utility. This looks like a systemic habit across this whole family of shared utility files, not an isolated mistake.
